'''2021 U.S. National Championship''' was the Players Committee U.S. National Championship in Colorado, 17–18 July 2021. [[Joe Olson]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-us-nationals/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Denver, Colorado
* '''Dates:''' 17–18 July 2021
